latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 11 cycles for 0/Inf/NaN/negative; 15 for exact squares 1, 4, 0.25 and minnorm; 33 for general inputs; 34 for maxsub and minsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: frsqrt.s $f0, $f8; frsqrt.s $f1, $f9; frsqrt.s $f2, $f10; frsqrt.s $f3, $f11; frsqrt.s $f4, $f12; frsqrt.s $f5, $f13; frsqrt.s $f6, $f14; frsqrt.s $f7, $f15

throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 6.0 for special values; 8.0 for exact squares; 17.0 for general inputs; 17.5 for maxsub and minsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency 11-34 cycles and throughput CPI 6-17.5 are data-dependent; the stored experiments use representative operand samples.
